title: Talking Portrait
buildableVersion: A screen or web app that listens, responds in character, and reacts using voice or camera input.
safeDemoMoment: A visitor asks the portrait for advice and receives an overdramatic response.

title: Wand Interface
buildableVersion: A gesture-controlled physical wand that triggers actions such as changing slides, switching lights, or controlling a web app.
safeDemoMoment: A participant performs a spell gesture and the room responds.

title: Web-Slinger Prop
buildableVersion: A completely non-hazardous wrist prop that uses lights, sound, or haptics instead of real projectiles.
safeDemoMoment: A wrist gesture triggers a web animation, sound cue, or harmless light effect.

title: Personal AI Sidekick
buildableVersion: A voice or chat assistant that performs small theatrical tasks, narrates actions, or triggers simple web automations.
safeDemoMoment: The AI gives the team a theatrical mission briefing and triggers one harmless automation.

title: Reality Rewrite Console
buildableVersion: An app that takes a simple scene, story, or room layout and generates safe alternate versions using text, images, sound, or projected light.
safeDemoMoment: A participant changes one detail and the system transforms the whole scene in front of the audience.

title: Suit Copilot
inspiredBy: Ironheart's self-built armor and AI assistant.
buildableVersion: A wearable or desktop copilot that reads sensors, answers voice questions, reports system status, and suggests the next build step.
safeDemoMoment: A participant asks the copilot for a status report and the suit responds using lights, a screen, or audio.

title: Krypton Check-In
inspiredBy: Supergirl's enhanced senses and her concern for people at a distance.
buildableVersion: An opt-in app for checking how teammates are doing through a simple status, mood, or ‘need help’ signal—without tracking location or reading private messages.
safeDemoMoment: A team member taps a status button and the shared mission board updates with a clear, human-readable signal.

title: Enhanced Senses Viewer
buildableVersion: A camera-and-microphone tool that magnifies, color-codes, captions, or filters ordinary environmental signals for a safe demonstration.
safeDemoMoment: The viewer reveals a hidden color, quiet sound, or small visual detail and explains the result in text.

title: Spell Command Gauntlet
inspiredBy: Wanda's energy control and gesture-based magic.
buildableVersion: A glove, wristband, or handheld controller with an accelerometer, LED ring, and haptic motor that maps gestures to software or room effects.
safeDemoMoment: A hand movement triggers a glowing pattern, vibration, and a harmless change on screen.

title: Armor Diagnostics Kit
inspiredBy: Ironheart's powered armor and engineering mindset.
buildableVersion: A safe wearable frame or backpack with temperature, light, motion, and battery sensors that displays live diagnostics on a small screen.
safeDemoMoment: The builder moves, covers a light sensor, or warms the device slightly and the armor dashboard reacts.

title: Rescue Beacon
inspiredBy: Cosmic heroes coordinating help across long distances.
buildableVersion: A tabletop hardware beacon with buttons, LEDs, a buzzer, and a local wireless message that lets a team request help or announce a mission state.
safeDemoMoment: Pressing the beacon changes the signal from ‘available’ to ‘need a hand,’ and the nearby team display responds.

title: Transformation Console
inspiredBy: Magical transformation sequences such as Sailor Moon's.
buildableVersion: A personal, non-competitive transformation sequence with captions, sound controls, visual effects, and a choice of character or avatar.
safeDemoMoment: A visitor chooses their effects and controls, then activates a short transformation sequence through sight, sound, or text.

title: Princess Alliance Mission Board
inspiredBy: Team-based magical heroes and the Princess Alliance.
buildableVersion: A collaborative mission board where each teammate chooses a role—builder, storyteller, tester, designer, researcher, or presenter.
safeDemoMoment: The board shows how different contributions combine to complete one shared quest.

title: Enchanted Garden Caretaker
inspiredBy: Magical gardens and nature-centered fantasy stories.
buildableVersion: A garden installation that responds to gentle touch, keyboard input, or voice and gives every visitor a different low-pressure creative challenge.
safeDemoMoment: Two visitors use different input methods and both help the garden bloom.
